title: Kernel infer_let ignores dependencies in let-binding types
summary: The kernel's infer_let decides which variables to abstract in the result type without accounting for dependencies in the type of a let binding, so inferType/check can return an expression with a loose free variable and a second check on it fails. The second kernel bug found by the Lean4Lean verification; the reporter did not find an exploit.

links.label: Checked by Tenet, tenet-hs and tenet-jvm (independent kernels)
